name: Triangle Pose
description: Straight-legged wide stance tilting the torso over the front leg, arms in one vertical line.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand with your feet about a leg's length apart; turn your front foot out and your back foot slightly in.
Reach your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.

keyframes.name: Step wide
keyframes.cue: Step the feet wide apart, arms out to the sides.

keyframes.name: Triangle Pose
keyframes.cue: Reach over the right leg, lower the right hand, lift the left arm.

cues: Lengthen both sides of the waist.
